description: Opt-in companion to the fleet preset for a repository whose branch protection requires the head branch to be up to date and that has no merge queue. The fleet default is rebaseWhen conflicted: rebasing on every main commit re-armed auto-merge after each ejection and fed the merge-queue loop (trellis#731), and a queue already tests the combined result. Without a queue, conflicted leaves a Renovate PR stranded behind main until it conflicts (foundation). Extend this AFTER the fleet preset so the scalar wins: { "extends": ["github>MustardSeedNetworks/.github", "github>MustardSeedNetworks/.github//presets/rebase-when-behind"] }. Listed first, the fleet preset's conflicted value overwrites this one.
